customManagers.description: Images in the module compose templates and in the committed rendered example, pinned by tag and index digest, one dependency so a bump moves the tag and the digest of both in one branch
Images the workflows and the e2e box run with docker run, pinned by tag and digest so a bump moves both

packageRules.description: The rendered example belongs to the regex manager above; the stock compose manager would bump it apart from the templates
The restore drill keeps one PostgreSQL image per major; a major bump would turn one line into another, a new major is a new line in the template
Container images: one weekly PR for minor, patch and a new digest under the same tag, every major alone

An image bump also changes the derived parts of the committed example render (the image lists of the vulns and eol agents, the portal, the render index), so every image branch renders the example again and commits only examples/rendered; the host's Renovate runs it only when its allowedCommands lists this exact command

commands: uv run --frozen --no-dev aye render examples/acme.yaml -o examples/rendered --build-time "2026-01-01 00:00 UTC" --commit example
